narr: Persistent moist monsoonal flow fueled thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. Several storms produced flash flooding and severe weather.
ev: Water, mud, and rocks covered Temple Bar Road 8 miles west of Temple Bar.
The Archibald Wash flooded Pierce Ferry Road.
Several roads in Golden Valley were closed.
Hualapai Mountain Road was closed from mile marker 4.5 to the ranger station.
